title: Learning Graph Viewer
description: Interactive visualization of the complete 200-concept Algebra I learning graph with search, zoom, and dependency traversal.
subject: Algebra I
Learning Graph
Concept Network
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify prerequisite relationships between Algebra 1 concepts by following directed edges in the learning graph
Locate a specific concept node using the type-ahead search and inspect its incoming and outgoing dependencies
Filter the graph by taxonomy category checkboxes to isolate one topic area, such as foundation concepts, for study planning
Interpret the node, edge, and orphan statistics to spot disconnected concepts that indicate gaps in the learning graph

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive visual modeling with step-by-step exploration and immediate feedback
keyQuestions: What mathematical relationship is illustrated by this model?
How does changing one variable or parameter influence the outcome?
commonMisconceptions: Confusing visual scale or orientation with underlying numeric operations
assessmentOpportunities: Explain the displayed relationship in student's own words
Solve an algebraic problem and confirm result with the interactive model

creator: Dan McCreary

learningObjectives: Navigate the directed acyclic graph (DAG) of 200 algebra concepts to understand learning progressions.
prerequisites: Introductory familiarity with variables and algebraic expressions
